target_audience: London investors, commercial agricultural producers, equipment manufacturers, pilot customers, strategic partners
app_type: Industrial IoT SCADA SaaS Investor Demo Dashboard
theme: Dark Industrial SCADA / High-Tech Agritech Command Center
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a world-class, high-density, ISA-18.2 compliant industrial SCADA investor-demo dashboard for SmartDry Connect™ by Adebobo Dynamic Resources. The app monitors a commercial hybrid LPG hot-air agricultural dryer equipped with solar/battery electrical controls, ESP32 IoT sensors (temperature, humidity, load-cell weight, gas detection, OLED local display). No authentication required — opens directly to the Dashboard. Include a persistent top banner: 'SIMULATED / DEMO DATA — NOT PILOT RESULTS'. Ensure all 7 core sections are fully interactive, rich with real-time simulated telemetry, responsive, and visually stunning with custom SVG gauges, Recharts line charts, batch form handlers, scannable QR codes, and system architecture diagrams. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

anti_ai_slop_rules: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or plain light Bootstrap cards. Use a dark, industrial command-center aesthetic.
DO NOT use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons exclusively.
DO NOT use transition: all globally. Apply targeted CSS transitions to hover and active states.
DO NOT center align the app container. Use left-aligned, structured grid containers for scanability.
Always set explicit hover text colors (e.g. hover:bg-emerald-600 hover:text-white).
Ensure all card borders have subtle 1px slate-800 or emerald-950/40 inner glow borders with crisp dark backdrop blur.
Persistent demo badge must remain pinned at the top header or toolbar: 'SIMULATED / DEMO DATA — NOT PILOT RESULTS'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_convention: All buttons, inputs, links, tabs, tables, gauge indicators, and cards MUST include data-testid in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='live-monitor-start-button').

typography.font_pairings: Outfit for section titles and high-impact hero headings; JetBrains Mono for sensor values, units, timestamps, batch IDs, and terminal logs.

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / INDUSTRIAL HIGH-TECH (Dark SCADA)
colors.contrast_rules: All normal text has >5:1 contrast against dark slate surfaces. Gauge numbers are rendered in high-luminance lime/emerald (#10B981) or cyan (#38BDF8) on dark background for high legibility in control room conditions.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Generous industrial padding (p-4 to p-8). Grid gaps min gap-4, max gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.bento_strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B for Dashboards/SCADA). Summary metric cards in 4-col top row, primary telemetry charts spanning 2-3 cols, telemetry gauge panel spanning 1-2 cols.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar (width 256px on desktop, collapsable on mobile) with company logo 'SmartDry Connect™', sub-label 'by Adebobo Dynamic Resources', navigation links, real-time status pill, and 'SIMULATED DATA' badge.

components_and_sections.name: 1. Overview Dashboard
key_elements: Dryer Operational Status Card (Idle / Drying / Cooling / Alarm)
Live Telemetry Quick Cards: Chamber Temp (°C), RH (%), Crop Weight (kg), Gas Safety Level (PPM)
Active Batch Summary Card (Batch ID, Crop Type, Target Moisture vs Current Moisture, Drying Time Elapsed)
Power Source Indicator (Solar PV vs LPG Thermal vs Battery Buffer)
ESP32 → Cloud → Dashboard Connectivity Signal Flow Widget (Packet frequency, Latency, RSSI dBm)
Global Simulated Data Banner & Quick Action Buttons (Jump to Monitor, New Batch)

components_and_sections.name: 2. Live Drying Monitor (SCADA Control)
key_elements: Real-Time SCADA Command Bar with START / PAUSE / STOP drying cycle controls & simulated toggle state
Interactive SVG Circular Gauge Dials: 1) Thermal Chamber Temp (°C with setpoint needle), 2) Humidity RH (%), 3) LPG Gas Detector (PPM safety range)
Real-time Telemetry Line Chart (Recharts) plotting Temp (°C), Humidity (%), and Moisture loss over time with range filters (15m, 1h, 6h, Full Batch)
Drying Stage Progress Bar (Pre-heating → Moisture Extraction → Constant Rate → Falling Rate → Cooling)
Control Parameters Panel: Hot Air Blower Fan Speed (RPM), LPG Valve Solenoid State, Tray Load Balancer status

components_and_sections.name: 3. New Batch Registration Form
key_elements: Form fields: Batch ID (auto-generated e.g. SDC-2026-089), Product Crop (Cassava, Ginger, Cocoa, Maize, Hibiscus, Plantain), Starting Moisture %, Target Moisture %, Initial Weight (kg), Number of Trays, Assigned Operator, Hybrid Thermal Method (Solar+LPG / Solar Only / LPG Boost), Start Datetime
Expected Drying Duration Calculator & Fuel Cost Estimator preview based on input parameters
Form validation, Sonner toast notification on batch submit, auto-route option to Live Monitor

components_and_sections.name: 4. Batch History & Traceability Table
key_elements: Interactive Data Table with Search, Product Filter, and Status Badges (Completed, In-Progress, Aborted)
Columns: Batch ID, Crop, Start Date, Initial Wt (kg), Final Wt (kg), Yield %, Total kWh, LPG Used (kg), Traceability Score, Actions (View QR, Export Audit PDF)
Modal or Drawer for detailed batch audit log (Temp curves, operator notes, quality certification)

components_and_sections.name: 5. Energy & Performance Analytics
key_elements: KPI Cards: Total LPG Consumed (kg), Solar Energy Harvested (kWh), Battery Reserve (%), Energy per kg Dried (kWh/kg), Processing Cost per kg ($/kg)
Energy Source Contribution Donut/Bar Chart (Solar PV vs LPG Gas vs Battery Storage)
Comparative Analytics Panel: Traditional Sun/Open Air Drying vs Diesel Hot-Air vs SmartDry™ Hybrid (Drying Speed, Cost/kg, Crop Quality Retention, CO2 Reduction)
Clear 'SIMULATED COMPARISON MODEL' disclaimers

components_and_sections.name: 6. QR Traceability Generator & Passport
key_elements: Interactive QR Code Generator per batch (Scannable QR that opens digital crop provenance passport)
Digital Batch Passport View: Farm origin, Harvest date, SmartDry drying thermal profile summary, Final moisture cert (10-12%), Export readiness grade, Operator digital sign-off
Download QR PNG & Print Label Preview for packaging bags

components_and_sections.name: 7. System Status & Architecture
key_elements: Hardware IoT Topology Diagram: Physical Hybrid Dryer → ESP32 MCU + Sensors (DHT22/PT100, Load Cell HX711, MQ-5 Gas, OLED) → MQTT/Wi-Fi Gateway → SmartDry Connect Cloud → Real-time UI
Subsystem Health Matrix: LPG Thermal Ignition, Solar MPPT Controller, Battery Management System, Load Cell Calibration, Gas Safety Cutoff Solenoid
Live Sensor Raw Data Feed / Terminal Stream Log (simulated JSON telemetry stream from ESP32)

micro_interactions: Hover elevation on metric cards with subtle emerald border highlight
Pulsing status LED dots (green = online/normal, amber = warning, red = alert)
Animated needle or stroke transition on SCADA gauge dials
Live pulsing dot on telemetry chart updates every 3 seconds
